name: Miyano Shion
source:
A tsundere (probably) character. Problem is that she’s more of cold than tsun. Ice cold. That’s why her nickname is Tsurara-hime. She bulldozes anyone who stands in her way and doesn’t choose how she does stuff as long as the job gets done. Also a 3rd-year student and sees [url=/c879]Setsuka[/url] as her rival. She’s just... evil.
